definitions.explanation: Far beyond the ordinary or average level. Used to describe abilities, qualities, or degrees that stand out significantly from the norm.

examples.japanese: {並外|なみはず}れた{才能|さいのう}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{並外|なみはず}れた{体力|たいりょく}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}だ。
{並外|なみはず}れた{努力|どりょく}をしなければ、{世界|せかい}チャンピオンにはなれない。
examples.english: You can't become a world champion without extraordinary effort.

notes:
USAGE:
{並外|なみはず}れた is the past-tense form of {並外|なみはず}れる (to be out of the ordinary), used as a pre-noun modifier. It almost always appears before a noun.

WORD FORMATION:
{並|なみ} (ordinary, average) + {外|はず}れる (to deviate from) — literally "deviated from the norm."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {並外|なみはず}れた{才能|さいのう}: extraordinary talent
- {並外|なみはず}れた{体力|たいりょく}: exceptional stamina
- {並外|なみはず}れた{努力|どりょく}: extraordinary effort
- {並外|なみはず}れた{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}: remarkable concentration
